text:
priya: quick postmortem follow-up — alert quieting/action tracking from yesterday's page storm. putting owners + short timelines here so we can close these out in 2 weeks. please ack and call out blockers.

alex: ack. i can take threshold tuning for the serving/latency alerts (high-p95 pages). i'll audit the last 7 days of spikes and propose new thresholds by EOD tomorrow.

maya: i'll own dedupe rules and suppressions. plan: 1) identify duplicate fingerprints, 2) add suppressions for known noisy signals, 3) add doc for future dedupe rules. est 3 working days. assigning to me: @maya :white_check_mark: 

tom: i'll handle runbook updates and add a simple metric to detect the recurring pattern (token-cache-miss-rate). i'll also add a smoke-test that runs post-deploy to catch regressions. need a review from @alex when i add the alert change.

priya: concrete action items (short):
1) Threshold audit (alex) — deliverable: proposed threshold PR, due: +1 business day (1725080721)
2) Dedupe/suppression rules (maya) — deliverable: suppression PR + test, due: +3 business days (1725349921)
3) Runbook + smoke-test (tom) — deliverable: runbook PR + CI job, due: +5 business days (1725512721)
4) Postmortem tracker update (priya) — add owners/timeline + spreadsheet link, due: today noon (1724990400)

alex: quick note on thresholds — we should avoid global increases that mask real regressions. i'll include per-cluster and per-service splits in the PR. example alert snippet i'll propose:
```
alert: HighLatencyCritical
expr: increase(latency_p95{service="inference"}[5m]) > 50
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: critical
annotations:
  runbook: >-
    https://redwood-internal/runbooks/high-latency
```

maya: also adding temporary non-paging label to a few noisy alerts while we test changes. will mark as non-paging in the suppression PR and keep audit logs.

ops-lead: pinging on ownership: please add these action items to the postmortem tracker spreadsheet here: https://docs.internal/redwood/pm-alerts and include the expected fallout criteria (how we measure success: 50% reduction in duplicate pages, <1 pager/week for this class). I'll review on Friday.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: suppression PR #482 merged to staging by maya at 1725010000 — smoke-tests queued.

maya: smoke-tests passed in staging, moving to canary. tagging @tom for runbook update link in PR.

tom: looked at the PR, left one nit about alert label naming. otherwise LGTM. i'll merge once alex updates the thresholds PR.

alex: thresholds PR open: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pulls/39 — requesting reviews from @maya and @tom. added per-cluster override and a small backoff window.

priya: thanks everyone. i've added all items to the postmortem tracker and set recurring 30m check-ins every Tuesday for 2 weeks. will close items when merged + verified in prod metrics. if anyone needs extra time call it out here.

maya: timeline looks good. if we hit weird fallout i'll revert suppression and escalate.

ops-lead: green plan — if pages don't drop in 7 days after merge, escalate to oncall rotation review. otherwise we'll mark as resolved and fold rules into the alert-pruning playbook.

alex: ack, will monitor and post a metric snapshot after each deploy.

priya: closing note — thanks for quick turnaround. expected closure target: 1725512721 (two weeks). :rocket:
